title: Irrigation Form
subtitle: Farm Irrigation: captures actual activity and handoff.
description: Irrigation Form covers field or block, water source, pump, distribution zone, schedule, reading, and crop response. The irrigation coordinator records Farm Irrigation activity, quantities, variance, and handoff. Irrigation Form keeps Farm Irrigation exceptions visible until the irrigation coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Irrigation Form at water source, pump station, mainline, valve zone, field, and runoff boundary. Document field or block, water source, pump, distribution zone, schedule, reading, and crop response identity before Farm Irrigation begins. Compare field or block, water source, pump, distribution zone, schedule, reading, and crop response findings with stated Farm Irrigation criteria; route unresolved Farm Irrigation issues to farm water-system reviewer.

sections.title: Operating context and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Farm Irrigation, identify responsible parties, water source, pump station, mainline, valve zone, field, and runoff boundary, and the linked field or block, water source, pump, distribution zone, schedule, reading, and crop response source.

fields.label: Water source, permit or allocation reference, and pump
Zone, valve, line, meter, and controller

sections.title: Activity observations and operating checks
sections.guidance: Capture Farm Irrigation facts for field or block, water source, pump, distribution zone, schedule, reading, and crop response; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Farm Irrigation operating checks
items: Leak, blockage, emitter, sprinkler, and uniformity
Runoff, erosion, ponding, and neighboring impact

sections.title: Retained evidence and next operating review
sections.guidance: Resolve open Farm Irrigation conditions; have irrigation coordinator assign the next Farm Irrigation owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Operating exceptions, holds, and retained evidence
items: Reading or delivered volume cannot be reconciled
blocks.guidance: Pause Farm Irrigation when water authority, supply, equipment, delivered volume, runoff, or field-impact concern remains unresolved. Retain the available Farm Irrigation proof and route unresolved field or block, water source, pump, distribution zone, schedule, reading, and crop response scope to irrigation coordinator.
